hypothesis_update.prior_hypothesis: PR430 source-level UNKNOWN_OUTCOME support is sufficient to close the integrated F2 post-dispatch uncertainty gap once executed.
hypothesis_update.counterevidence: The exact PR430 bytes correctly handle native EntityOSOutcomeUnknown but do not recognize F2 ExecutorOutcomeUnknown as the same uncertainty type.
hypothesis_update.revised_hypothesis: The integrated path needs exactly one explicit typed uncertainty ABI or adapter at the F2 callback-to-canonical EntityOS boundary so every observed post-dispatch ambiguous return is translated into the one canonical unknown-outcome type before EffectGate finalization.
hypothesis_update.design_constraint: The adapter must not become a second effect authority, journal, completion authority, or replay authority. EffectGate+EffectJournal remain canonical.

next_exact_action: Do not merge PR25 or PR430 as authority merely because native candidate tests pass. First define a single fail-closed typed UNKNOWN_OUTCOME ABI/adapter at the existing F2 callback-to-canonical EffectGate boundary. The adapter must translate only an already-observed post-dispatch ambiguous executor outcome (currently ExecutorOutcomeUnknown) into the canonical EntityOSOutcomeUnknown semantics, preserve request/call/effect identity, forbid automatic replay, and leave all pre-dispatch failures definite. Then execute a byte/source-bound no-real-effect integration test proving the translated F2 post-start timeout and ordinary return-path exception terminalize as UNKNOWN_OUTCOME rather than FAILED before any successor canonical implementation binding is admitted.
